about_the_game:
• In this asymmetric multiplayer horror experience; one player takes on the role of the Slasher, a terrifying killer and the remaining players, and Victims; should escape from the campsite.

  • The Slasher never stops hunting. Track them. Trap them. Eliminate each victim without mercy. Unleash your inner maniac using brutal environmental kills."

  • Survive at all costs. Search the map for key items, solve deadly puzzles, and repair your escape—whether it’s through a gate, a vehicle, or a desperate call to the police. Trust is fragile. Betrayal is always lurking.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is an asymmetrical horror game with frequent graphical violence. Blood and gore are present, particularly during finishers, and violence is frequent.

detailed_description:
Victim Revealed!

A no-nonsense anarchist who’s used to trouble. This loudmouth rocker is abnormally good at keeping quiet, and her heavy boots are far more suited for kicking ass than running away.

Full backstory's link available on our official X account: @playsummercamp

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB (with Vulkan support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
